q: Do I need a visa to travel to China?
a: In most cases, no. China currently offers visa-free entry for short stays to travellers from many countries, including Australia, New Zealand, and parts of Europe. We’ll confirm the latest requirements and guide you through everything before departure.

q: Will there be any additional costs during the trip?
a: No hidden costs. All core elements of the journey are included. Any additional spending is personal and optional.

q: Do I need to prepare anything before the trip?
a: No. We handle all communication on the ground, so you won't need to worry about language during the journey.

q: What kind of travellers usually join?
a: Travellers who are curious, open, and looking for something beyond standard tours, or travellers who value experience over checklists.

q: Do I need to plan things myself during the trip?
a: No. Everything is taken care of — from flights to on-ground coordination. You can simply enjoy the journey.

q: Is this suitable for first-time visitors to China?
a: Yes. Our journeys are designed to make China accessible and comfortable, even if it’s your first time visiting.
